biomarkers.name: ER, PR, HER2
biomarkers.clinical_use: Typically managed as triple-negative breast cancer when receptor-negative

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA / PTEN / AKT pathway alterations
biomarkers.prevalence: Enriched versus unselected breast cancer; PI3K/AKT pathway alterations are common (often ~40-60% across series)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Potential eligibility for PI3K/AKT pathway-directed clinical trials; not an established standard predictive biomarker specific to metaplastic breast carcinoma

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Often positive in a substantial subset; assay and cutoff dependent
biomarkers.clinical_use: In metastatic triple-negative disease, pembrolizumab-based therapy may be used for PD-L1-positive tumors per TNBC indications

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.clinical_use: Tissue-agnostic pembrolizumab may apply if TMB-high by approved criteria

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Carcinoma with non-glandular (mesenchymal, squamous, spindle, chondroid) differentiation
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Usually high-grade; low-grade adenosquamous is exception

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; TILs often present but IO responses less predictable than typical TNBC
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Prominent mesenchymal or matrix-producing stroma is defining

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Usually a basal-like/claudin-low-associated breast carcinoma phenotype with mesenchymal or heterologous differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Ectoderm — mammary epithelium with metaplastic mesenchymal-like differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Heterogeneous — spindle cell, squamous, chondroid, osseous, or mixed differentiation; most cases are receptor-negative and overlap with basal-like/claudin-low intrinsic profiles
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents marked epithelial-mesenchymal transition with heterologous mesenchymal differentiation — retention of epithelial markers such as cytokeratins/p63 helps confirm epithelial origin despite mesenchymal appearance
